title: hooks-v1 result
description: What a hook answers (HTTP 200 with this JSON; 204 or an empty 200 is {action: continue}). The stage and the hook's role decide which actions are allowed (stages.json `actions`, `roles`); a patch may set or remove (null) only the stage's `fields`, a `content` field only at payload full; a decision holds only the stage's `decision` keys.

patch.description: field -> new value, null removes it (modify only)

reason.description: shown to the client on a deny; journaled (first 300 characters)

labels.description: at most 32 short values, carried to request.finished

retry.description: response.after_engine: send the request once more

answer.description: decision.ask: an option id of the question, or {choice, confidence?, probabilities?} (numbers 0..1); anything else is refused
